svg.text: An over-the-air update, step by step
Concept 3 · Node 1 1.7.0 → 1.7.1 · the server gives the order, the device downloads (HTTP, not MQTT)
not in the trial period, no other update
version not the running one, not below 1.7.0
sha256 64 hex digits, size ≤ the other shelf
http:// only to a home IP address (not the internet)
the update plan saved in NVS
the broker does NOT publish the offline will
badge stopped on purpose, the offline will is not published
over Wi-Fi + the router, not through the broker
every 4 KB written, the watchdog is fed
SHA-256 = the command's sha256? (if not: Update 15)
the first 16 bytes last → otadata switches shelves
reset_reason = SW; firmware 1.7.1 starts on the new shelf
connects to the broker (its key accepted) + online
+ cmd subscription within 60 seconds → firmware VALID
the report rides along with at most 3 vitals
the card changes without a reload
Failed BEFORE switching shelves: the old shelf stays
no restart → online again → vitals.ota failed + message:
first byte not 0xE9 or not arrived yet (-106 …)
download stopped halfway: 30 seconds without data (Update 6 …)
stuck, http://: the 60-second watchdog restarts → the old firmware reports
the new firmware not proven within 60 seconds, crashes, or
loses power during the trial → back to the old shelf; report
rollback, for example not connected to the broker within 60 seconds
A device offline or already updating: the server refuses
to send (409), the command is not queued
No word for 10 minutes (OTA_TIMEOUT_MINUTES): status expired;
a device report that arrives later overwrites it
Simulated lab (simulator; 1.7.1 real, not run): ack 5 ms,
succeeded 5.5 seconds after the click; on a board: not measured yet
